snippet.title: Plains & Prairies - Launch Trailer | Farming Simulator 25
snippet.description:
Welcome Ford to Farming Simulator 25 – a pioneer of industrialization. The Plains & Prairies Pack brings two classic Ford tractors to the game, alongside legendary machines like the Versatile 1080 “Big Roy”, the modern Fendt Rogator 900, and more. It's available now - and included in the Year 1 Season Pass.

🚜Get Farming Simulator 25 now!
